title.narrative: Agricultural Development: Inclusive Agricultural Value Chains Development Programme

description.narrative: The overall objective of DEFIS is to sustainably improve incomes and food and nutritional security for vulnerable rural people living in the programme area, transform family farming with the large-scale adoption of high-performing, resilient production systems, and integrate family farms into profitable value chains.
